# T-3: Guard side effects

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Ensure all retained target-sensitive side effects validate the binding against current authority immediately before mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate, set, dispatcher-owned target-sensitive command, reopen-draft, rewind-test-evidence, recover-existing-implementation, recover-review-pass, finalize, and finalize-cleanup paths fail with ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH before mutation when binding identity differs.
- A stale binding on reopen-draft is exercised as the representative repair-path CLI regression, and the remaining named repair paths are covered through their shared binding guard.
- Matching binding commands proceed when active authority is unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing flow-target-guard and flow-manager mismatch envelope patterns. Do not add automatic retry after mismatch.

## Test Strategy
Behavior-level CLI tests that compare artifacts before and after mismatched commands.
